d5_trajectory_quality.note: D5 correctly follows the diver when visible and detects the correct target at anchor frames. However, proxy resolution (202x360) causes flight-phase target switching and approach-phase detection gaps that break EL input quality.

prep_end_search.root_cause: 10-14s approach phase has 63% NO_DET. Large gaps (>0.20s) between valid frames yield vel=None (skipped). Valid frames that DO appear in 10-14s remain at cy_norm≈0.12, appearing as continued preparation. prep_end is only found at t=13.714s when velocity FIRST exceeds threshold due to actual takeoff motion being detected.

takeoff_search.note: Searches AFTER 13.814s — 0.07s after actual GT takeoff (13.754s)
takeoff_search.found: Spurious takeoff at t=14.882s — after actual water contact (GT=14.821s)!
takeoff_search.root_cause: Actual takeoff (13.75-14.1s) shows chaotic velocity due to target switching. No sustained 0.15s window of v < -0.04 exists in the flight phase. First sustained negative window found AFTER water entry, from post-wc target changing position.

diagnosis.explanation: D5_FRAMEWISE at op_conf=0.05 on 202x360 @ 29.97fps proxy videos fails to maintain continuous detection through the 1-1.5s dive flight. During STANDING approach (10-14s), detection drops to 37%, breaking EL prep detection. During flight, target switching between diver and background causes velocity noise >1.0 cy_norm/s that overwhelms the 0.04 threshold signal. EL V2.1/V2.2 were designed for high-resolution trajectories with ≥90% flight coverage. The proxy proxy video format violates this assumption.
diagnosis.supervisor_question_answered: The '~4 second failure' is that EL finds prep_end at 13.714s (4 frames before actual takeoff) because the 10-14s approach gap makes preparation appear to extend to that point. EL then misses the actual takeoff and finds a spurious one at 14.882s (after water contact). This is an EL scope limitation on proxy-resolution trajectories, not an independent Event Logic failure specific to Dive 311.
